title: NBI investigating ex-Velasco security aide's claims he delivered P2B to Sara Duterte
summary: The National Bureau of Investigation is investigating the claims of a policeman who served as a security officer for former Speaker Lord Allan Velasco. In an exclusive interview, Police Corporal…

blocks.text: The National Bureau of Investigation is investigating the claims of a policeman who served as a security officer for former Speaker Lord Allan Velasco.

In an exclusive interview, Police Corporal Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. said that he delivered suitcases containing cash to Vice President Sara Duterte, former President Rodrigo Duterte, and Davao City 1st District Representative Paolo Duterte on Velasco’s instructions.
Gracioso estimated that he had delivered a total of more than P2 billion to Sara Duterte.
“Aabot siguro ma’am, mga dalawang bilyon, lampas pa. Lahat-lahat. Mga P2B pataas.” (Probably around P2 billion, even more. More than P2 billion in all.)
Asked how many times he had brought Sara Duterte cash and gifts, he said: “Yung tanda ko lang siguro. More than 20 siguro.” (As far as I can recall, probably more than 20.)
Gracioso said he served as Velasco’s head of security beginning in 2018, when Velasco was a congressman, and continued working for him during his speakership from 2020 to 2022.

The National Bureau of Investigation gave GMA News a copy of Gracioso’s affidavit where he detailed alleged deliveries of suitcases containing P20 million to P50 million each to locations in Metro Manila, Davao, and elsewhere.
GMA News has sought comments through phone calls and messages from Sara Duterte, Pulong Duterte, Rodrigo Duterte, and Velasco since Thursday, but they have yet to give any. —LDF, GMA News
